lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four visible vertical columns on the posterior flank, exhibiting a semi-regular grid spacing prior to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-posterior region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank show a sharp luminance transition, with highlight on the dorsal aspect and high-contrast shadow on the ventral aspect, converging towards the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin macro-mask contains approximately 6-8 discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the lateral surface with higher density toward the base.

other_distinctive_markers: Caudal fin exhibits a high-density constellation of spots on both the upper and lower lobes, with a notable line of high-luminance spots following the trailing edge of the upper lobe.
